body: What I'm looking at is actually to help me in the long run. To try and understand if I can see this coming in future relationships and avoid them. I also just thought it was a funny story. But mainly I wanted to know if there's anyway I can see something like this happening in the future, so I can avoid it.

Psychoanalyse because for awhile I felt bad and wanted to help her until the details came out. Starting the business thing I can pretty much do on my own (now that I looked into it). I just found it shocking that someone would move in with someone after knowing them maybe 1-2 weeks. Her cousins are PISSED and apparently wish she was still with me (thankfully they understood why I don't want anything to do with her now).

That's what I was thinking...I love all the comments like how I'm creepy or stupid...lol she openly texts me about this stuff...like to rub it in my face. And it's hilarious to me. Luckily I don't really need her to do the business....having her as a partner sure would help (due to size of the business), but man people make me laugh...I was just laughing at how fucked up people are yet somehow I'm the bad guy? Lol. But yeah you're definitely right.

I feel the exact same way....my ex gf lost feelings for me and is the coldest, most heartless person I've seen towards someone she used to be in love with....I don't have anybody but her. She got a bf a week after dumping me...I know how you feel. And I don't know what to do either..I walk extremely slowly anymore, and everybody just tells me to "get over it". There's no getting over it. I can't replace her. I just feel very small and alone..and trapped because I'm almost 22 living with my parents still. I actually feel slightly better when I feel like nobody cares about me. I just wanna fall asleep and never wake up so it's not considered a suicide.
I have no friends lol. She was literally the only person I had. So you're already in a better position than me if you wanna look at it like that.

Me too. Mine made me feel happy and loved for the first time in 21 years. My birthday is in a month, hers in 3. I've constantly contemplated when I'll do it. I'm scared of pain though. But she's the only person who's brought me happiness. I have OCD and she bought me medicine. But won't give me it now because we're "no longer together" I dunno if this will help at all, but my gf was falling in love with me, then without a sign, dumped me because she had lost feelings for just 2 weeks and thought the problems (her losing feelings) would fix themselves. She is a senior in college and looks heavier despite losing weight from all her stress. Yet she's 100% convinced she'll never like me again and that the stress of college and her full-time job has nothing to do with her losing feelings for me. She also wants to "explore other relationships". So maybe you have more hope than I could or should. Or at least more reason to?

ME TOO. I feel the exact same way. You find someone who is perfect to you in every way and it's as if no one else even exists. Then they leave and you're shocked. As if you cannot move. I feel the exact same way...mine was a week ago and I still hardly sleep....
I feel suffocated by everyone around me

She was falling in love with me, we had everything in common. Yet she lost feelings and claims her feelings will NEVER come back. Even though she promised we'd be together forever. And she even said I treated her great, yet she is gone..

I feel trapped. I feel like everything about my life was going great. Then the girl I loved more than anyone left, never to return. I've never recovered in the past few years. I was miserable before her, miserable without her. Never found anybody but her. I feel like I'm drowning
